TestDisposeAfterLoad()

The async load completion callback is scheduled on the osu.Framework.Game. The callback is generally used to add the child to the container, however it is possible for the container to be disposed when this occurs due to being scheduled on the osu.Framework.Game. If this occurs, the cancellation is invoked and the completion task should not be run.

This is a very timing-dependent test which performs the following sequence: LoadAsync -> schedule Callback -> dispose parent -> invoke scheduled callback
